title: Pricing and Credits
description: The official waoowaoo cloud edition uses credits for AI text, image, video, and music generation. Users can top up through Stripe after creating an account.
betaNotice: Self-service top-up is available. Stripe currently supports enabled methods such as cards, Link, and Apple Pay; WeChat Pay and Alipay will appear in Checkout after payment-provider approval. Invite codes and manual grants are used only for trials, tests, or operational credits.

checkout.title: Top up and start generating
checkout.body: Top-ups use the live Stripe Checkout flow. Credits are valued in CNY and converted to HKD using the configured settlement rate. After Stripe confirms the payment through webhook, credits are added automatically.

details.usage: Usable for text, image, video, and music generation
For ongoing projects and multi-asset generation
For team projects and frequent video generation
details.support: Priority support and manual credit assistance

creditPolicy.title: Credit rules
creditPolicy.body: Credits are in-platform AI generation units. They are not cash, cannot be withdrawn, cannot be transferred, and cannot be used outside the platform. Actual deductions depend on task type, model, resolution, duration, and other factors. Final payment amount, currency, taxes, and available payment methods are shown on the Stripe Checkout page.
